notes: Initial component runs still failed because LOOKUP used dav_exists, which opened the target for data access. Replacing that existence query with the freshly reconciled namespace entry removed the remaining unintended open.
Protocol component tests use the existing explicitly injected provider after proving the production provider declines wire:true; no production gate bypass was added.
Linux 6.19 QEMU has no network or host filesystem shares; tmpfs and a disposable ext4 disk both require positive delegation support.
Native core and protocol/lifecycle tests use Clang ASan/UBSan/LSan. The kernel guest uses a separate GCC release binary. Default Clang debug configuration was restored.

The older-kernel component provider cannot protect namespace mutations, so its real rename/replacement check verifies identity validation. Linux 6.19 separately proves conflicting host mutations block until release.
